name: Salesforce
one_liner: The original enterprise CRM; sales, service and platform in one.
access_note: Free Developer Edition org signs up instantly at developer.salesforce.com; production API access lives on paid orgs.
api_surface: REST, SOAP, Bulk and GraphQL APIs; very broad.

name: HubSpot
one_liner: CRM, marketing and support suite built around a free-forever core.
access_note: Free HubSpot account and free developer test account, private-app token instantly.
api_surface: REST API, broad (CRM, marketing, CMS, tickets).

name: Pipedrive
one_liner: Pipeline-first CRM for small sales teams.
access_note: 14-day free trial; API token available immediately in Settings.
api_surface: REST API, broad; GraphQL in limited beta.

name: Attio
one_liner: Modern, flexible/no-schema CRM aimed at startups.
access_note: Free plan available; API key generated instantly in workspace settings.

name: Twenty
one_liner: Open-source, self-hostable CRM alternative to Salesforce.
access_note: Fully open-source, self-host free, or use the managed Twenty Cloud.
api_surface: REST + GraphQL, auto-generated from the data model.

name: Podio
one_liner: Citrix/GoTo-owned flexible work-management and light CRM tool.
access_note: Free developer account, register a client at developers.podio.com; OAuth flows (server-side, app, password) all documented.
api_surface: REST API, moderate; docs feel dated but functional.
blocker: Aging, sparsely-maintained docs and community; product has visibly low ongoing SaaS investment.

name: Zoho CRM
one_liner: CRM module of the wider Zoho business suite.
access_note: Free Zoho account, self-serve API console and OAuth client registration.

name: Close
one_liner: Inside-sales CRM with built-in calling and email.
access_note: 14-day free trial; API key generated instantly.
api_surface: REST API, broad for a sales CRM.

name: Copper
one_liner: CRM built natively into Google Workspace.
access_note: Free trial; API key self-serve from settings.

name: DealCloud
one_liner: Relationship-intelligence CRM for private equity and investment banking.
access_note: No public trial or self-serve signup; API capability must be switched on by a DealCloud admin inside an existing paid tenant.
api_surface: REST API, broad, well-documented once inside.
blocker: Requires an existing paid enterprise DealCloud (Intapp) contract before any credentials can be issued.

name: Zendesk
one_liner: Widely-used customer service and ticketing platform.
access_note: Free trial; API token self-serve instantly.
api_surface: REST API, very broad (Support, Chat, Talk, Guide...).

name: Intercom
one_liner: Customer messaging and support platform.
access_note: Free developer workspace for building/testing even though paid plans dropped a general free tier.
api_surface: REST API, broad; GraphQL in beta.

name: Freshdesk
one_liner: Freshworks' customer support / ticketing product.
access_note: Free Sprout plan and 21-day trial; API key self-serve.

name: Front
one_liner: Shared-inbox customer communication platform.
access_note: Free trial; some API capabilities reserved for higher plan tiers.
blocker: Certain API scopes are plan-gated above the trial tier.

name: Pylon
one_liner: B2B-focused support/helpdesk tool built for SaaS companies.
access_note: Free trial; admin generates a bearer token from the dashboard.
api_surface: REST API spanning 22+ documented resource groups.

name: LiveAgent
one_liner: Multi-channel help-desk software.
access_note: Free trial; API key self-serve from Configuration > System > API.
api_surface: REST API v3, broad, with in-app Swagger docs per account.

name: Plain
one_liner: Developer-first customer support tool built around Slack/Discord-style UX.
access_note: Free starter plan; API key self-serve via Machine Users.

name: Help Scout
one_liner: Simple shared-inbox help desk for small teams.
access_note: 15-day free trial; OAuth app registration self-serve.

name: Gorgias
one_liner: Ecommerce-focused customer support helpdesk (big on Shopify).
access_note: Free trial; API key self-serve.

name: Gladly
one_liner: Enterprise "people-based" customer service platform.
access_note: No public self-serve signup found; API token requires an existing Gladly account and admin-granted API User permission.
blocker: Enterprise sales-led onboarding; no public trial to obtain a workspace in the first place.

name: Slack
one_liner: The default team-chat platform, huge app ecosystem.
access_note: Free workspace, self-serve app creation at api.slack.com.
api_surface: REST (Web API) + Events API + Socket Mode; very broad.

name: Twilio
one_liner: Programmable SMS, voice and video infrastructure.
access_note: Free trial account with trial credit, self-serve signup.
api_surface: REST API, very broad (SMS, Voice, Video, Verify...).

name: Zoho Cliq
one_liner: Team chat product inside the Zoho suite.
access_note: Free tier; Zoho API console self-serve OAuth client.

name: Lark (Larksuite)
one_liner: ByteDance's all-in-one workspace/collaboration suite.
access_note: Free self-serve developer console at open.larksuite.com; create an app instantly.
api_surface: Server API, very broad (messaging, docs, calendar, contacts).
blocker: Non-standard, dual-token auth model (not vanilla OAuth2) adds integration overhead; our crawler could not get usable text off the JS-heavy docs homepage.

name: Pumble
one_liner: Free-forever team chat app aimed at small businesses.
access_note: Free plan; API key generated via an in-app slash command ("/api-keys generate").
api_surface: REST API, narrow (messaging + incoming webhooks mainly).

name: Discord
one_liner: Community chat platform, bots and gateway events.
access_note: Free, instant self-serve developer portal.

name: Telegram
one_liner: Messaging app with a famously open bot platform.
access_note: Fully free and instant; no approval process at all.
api_surface: Bot API (HTTP) + MTProto client API; broad.

name: WhatsApp Business
one_liner: Meta's business messaging channel (Cloud API).
access_note: Nominally self-serve via Meta for Developers, but real production use needs business verification, phone-number registration and app review.
blocker: Business verification + Meta App Review friction before production messaging works.
crawler_note: Every URL on developers.facebook.com returned HTTP 400 to our crawler regardless of path — Meta blocks simple bot requests outright.

name: Aircall
one_liner: Cloud call-center / VoIP phone system.
access_note: Requires an active (trial) subscription; API credentials then self-serve from integration settings.

name: Vonage
one_liner: Communications APIs (SMS, Voice, Verify) — Twilio competitor.
access_note: Free trial with credit, self-serve signup.
api_surface: REST APIs, broad, split across several products.

name: Google Ads
one_liner: Google's advertising platform API.
access_note: OAuth is self-serve, but a Developer Token requires a Google application + manual review before real (non-test) access.
blocker: Developer Token approval can take days and Google reviews the use case.

name: Meta Ads
one_liner: Facebook/Instagram advertising platform API.
access_note: Self-serve app creation, but ads_management and similar scopes require Business Verification + App Review.
blocker: Business verification + App Review gate before real ad spend can be managed.
crawler_note: Blocked with HTTP 400 by our crawler, same as all developers.facebook.com paths.

name: LinkedIn Ads
one_liner: LinkedIn's advertising / marketing API.
access_note: Requires applying to LinkedIn's Marketing Developer Platform partner program; manual approval, often expects an existing ad-spend relationship.
blocker: Partner-program approval, not open self-serve signup.

name: GoHighLevel
one_liner: All-in-one sales/marketing platform for agencies.
access_note: Free developer account on the Marketplace; create a Private app instantly.

name: Mailchimp
one_liner: Email marketing and automation platform.
access_note: Free plan; API key self-serve instantly.

name: Klaviyo
one_liner: Ecommerce-focused email/SMS marketing platform.
access_note: Free tier; private API key self-serve.

name: systeme.io
one_liner: All-in-one funnel builder / course platform.
access_note: Free plan; API key self-serve from settings.
blocker: Small API surface relative to the product.

name: Pinterest
one_liner: Visual discovery/social platform with an ads and content API.
access_note: Free developer account, but Standard (production-volume) Access requires an app review.
blocker: App review gate for production-tier access.

name: Threads (Meta)
one_liner: Meta's text-based social app, now with a public API.
access_note: Self-serve app creation; publish permissions need App Review.
blocker: App Review gate, same family as WhatsApp/Meta Ads.
crawler_note: Blocked with HTTP 400 by our crawler, same as all developers.facebook.com paths.

name: SendGrid
one_liner: Transactional and marketing email delivery API (Twilio-owned).
access_note: Free tier (100 emails/day); API key instant self-serve.

name: Shopify
one_liner: The dominant hosted ecommerce platform.
access_note: Free Partner account + free dev store, instant.
api_surface: REST (being sunset) + GraphQL Admin API; very broad.

name: WooCommerce
one_liner: Open-source ecommerce plugin for WordPress.
access_note: Free/open source, self-hosted — you own the whole stack.

name: BigCommerce
one_liner: Hosted ecommerce platform, SMB-to-enterprise.
access_note: Free trial store; API account self-serve.

name: Salesforce Commerce Cloud
one_liner: Enterprise ecommerce platform (formerly Demandware).
access_note: No public signup; sandboxes are provisioned by Salesforce or an implementation partner under an existing contract.
api_surface: OCAPI (legacy) + SCAPI (REST); broad, but inaccessible without a tenant.
blocker: No self-serve sandbox at all; fully partner/enterprise-gated.

name: Magento (Adobe Commerce)
one_liner: Open-source ecommerce platform now owned by Adobe.
access_note: Magento Open Source is free/self-hosted (self-serve); Adobe Commerce (the paid SaaS tier) is sold via sales.
blocker: Split product: only the free open-source edition is self-serve; the commercial SaaS tier is gated.

name: Squarespace
one_liner: Website builder with an ecommerce/Commerce tier.
access_note: Requires an active paid Commerce plan; OAuth app creation is then self-serve via the developer platform.
blocker: Paid-plan prerequisite before any API access.

name: Ecwid
one_liner: Lightweight ecommerce widget you can embed anywhere.
access_note: Free plan; API token self-serve from the control panel.

name: Gumroad
one_liner: Simple storefront for creators selling digital products.
access_note: Free creator signup; OAuth app registration self-serve, access token generated directly on the app page.
api_surface: REST API, actually broad (products, sales, subscribers, licenses, payouts, media, workflows...); ships an official CLI explicitly "built for humans and AI agents alike."
mcp: None known, but the CLI is explicitly agent-oriented
verification_note: CORRECTED after manual check: first-pass crawl hit a stale help-center redirect (help.gumroad.com/article/280-api-guide, 19 chars) and wrongly concluded the docs were thin/narrow. The real docs at app.gumroad.com/api are comprehensive.

name: Amazon Selling Partner
one_liner: Amazon's API for sellers and vendors (SP-API).
access_note: Requires an approved Amazon Seller/Vendor account, then a registered SP-API app that Amazon reviews per role.
blocker: Dual authentication scheme plus per-role Amazon approval — a real integration-effort blocker, not just a policy one.

name: fanbasis
one_liner: Checkout/payments platform for creators and coaches.
access_note: Self-serve signup with a free sandbox environment before going live.
api_surface: REST API, moderate, with an interactive docs playground.

name: DataForSEO
one_liner: Pay-as-you-go SEO and SERP data API.
access_note: Pay-as-you-go signup, no sales call, free trial credits.

name: SE Ranking
one_liner: SEO/rank-tracking platform with an API add-on.
access_note: Requires an active paid subscription; API key generation is then self-serve.
blocker: No free tier — a paid plan is the entry cost.

name: Ahrefs
one_liner: SEO/backlink research platform.
access_note: API included from the Lite plan up ($129/mo+) as of 2026, after being Enterprise-only ($1,499/mo+) previously; key self-serve in account settings.
blocker: Priced out of reach rather than sales-gated — a cost barrier, not an approval one.

name: MrScraper
one_liner: Web-scraping API (SERP, residential proxy, general scraping).
access_note: Self-serve signup with a token generated from the user profile.

name: Apify
one_liner: Cloud platform for web scrapers and browser automation ("Actors").
access_note: Free tier with monthly credits; token instant self-serve.
api_surface: REST API, broad, and thousands of pre-built Actors.

name: Firecrawl
one_liner: LLM-ready web scraping/crawling API.
access_note: Free tier (starter credits), instant self-serve signup.
api_surface: REST API, moderate, purpose-built for feeding LLMs/agents.

name: Bright Data
one_liner: Large-scale proxy network and web-data platform.
access_note: Free trial credit self-serve signup; larger residential-proxy volume can trigger a compliance/KYC review.
blocker: Compliance review for higher-volume/residential proxy use cases specifically.

name: Sherlock
one_liner: Open-source CLI that finds usernames across social sites.
access_note: No account, no auth; run the Python script locally.
api_surface: Not a hosted API at all — a local CLI to wrap, a fundamentally different integration shape.
blocker: Not a SaaS/API integration — would need to ship as a sandboxed local-execution skill, not a hosted toolkit.

name: Waterfall.io
one_liner: B2B contact/company enrichment API ("waterfalls" across 30+ data vendors).
access_note: Free signup; every user gets an API key immediately.

name: Clay
one_liner: Spreadsheet-native, agent-adjacent contact/company data enrichment platform.
access_note: Free tier and self-serve credits for the table product; the native People/Company REST API is Enterprise-only.
api_surface: Primarily inbound/outbound webhooks, not a general CRUD REST API; has documented MCP settings.
blocker: The general-purpose REST API is Enterprise-gated; only webhook-based access is broadly self-serve.

name: GitHub
one_liner: Code hosting, the default dev platform.
access_note: Free, instant.

name: Vercel
one_liner: Frontend hosting/deployment platform.
access_note: Free Hobby plan; token self-serve instantly.

name: Netlify
one_liner: Static site/JAMstack hosting and deployment.

name: Cloudflare
one_liner: CDN, DNS, security and edge-compute platform.

one_liner: Graph database.

api_surface: HTTP query API + Bolt drivers + Aura Management REST API.

name: Snowflake

access_note: 30-day free trial with credits, self-serve signup, API included.
api_surface: SQL API (REST) + Snowpipe REST API; broad.

name: MongoDB Atlas
one_liner: Managed MongoDB database service.

api_surface: Administration REST API + Data API; broad.

name: Datadog

name: Sentry
one_liner: Error tracking and performance monitoring.
access_note: Free Developer tier; token self-serve instantly.

name: Notion
one_liner: Docs/wiki/database workspace tool.
access_note: Free personal plan; internal integration token self-serve instantly.

name: Airtable
one_liner: Spreadsheet-database hybrid.
access_note: Free tier; PAT self-serve instantly.

name: Linear
one_liner: Issue tracker built for fast-moving software teams.
access_note: Free tier; API key self-serve instantly.

name: Jira
one_liner: Atlassian's issue/project tracker.
access_note: Free tier (up to 10 users); API token self-serve instantly.
api_surface: REST API, very broad; limited GraphQL.

name: Asana
one_liner: Task/project management tool.
access_note: Free tier; PAT self-serve instantly.

name: Monday.com
one_liner: Work-OS style project/workflow management tool.
access_note: Free tier; API key self-serve instantly.

name: ClickUp
one_liner: All-in-one project management/productivity suite.
access_note: Free-forever plan; token self-serve instantly.

name: Coda
one_liner: Doc-meets-spreadsheet-meets-app tool.
access_note: Free tier; token self-serve instantly.

name: Smartsheet
one_liner: Spreadsheet-style project management platform.
access_note: Free 30-day trial; token self-serve instantly.

name: Harvest
one_liner: Time-tracking and invoicing tool.
access_note: Free 30-day trial; PAT self-serve instantly.

name: Stripe
one_liner: The reference-standard payments API.
auth: API key (HTTP Basic Auth, key as username)
access_note: Instant free signup, test-mode keys immediately.
api_surface: REST API, very broad; the industry benchmark for API design.
verification_note: Minor correction after manual check: primary scheme is HTTP Basic Auth (key as username, no password), not plain Bearer.

name: Plaid
one_liner: Bank-account linking and financial data API.
access_note: Free Sandbox self-serve instantly; Production access needs Plaid to review and approve your use case.
blocker: Production tier gated behind a use-case review, though Sandbox is fully open.

name: Binance
one_liner: Crypto exchange trading API.
access_note: Free account signup, API key self-serve instantly (KYC tier affects limits).
blocker: Custom cryptographic request-signing scheme (not OAuth/plain bearer) adds integration effort.

name: Paygent Connect
one_liner: Payment gateway product described as "NMI-powered" in the brief.
auth: Unverified — likely inherits NMI's partner-issued security-key model
access_note: Could not locate an independently documented "Paygent Connect" product; NMI's own gateway is provisioned via a partner portal, not public self-serve signup.
blocker: This app defeated our research: no discoverable public docs, only the underlying NMI platform's partner-gated model as a proxy. Needs direct vendor outreach to resolve.

name: iPayX
one_liner: FINTRAC-registered forensic FX-fee audit tool, marketed as "MCP-native."
auth: Unverified — no public API reference found
access_note: Real, very new product (not the unrelated "iPay" Africa/Jack Henry product our search first surfaced). Homepage explicitly advertises "Live in Claude MCP · n8n · Zapier" and an MCP-Agent-Developer persona ("Connect via MCP SSE"), but there is no public /docs or /api page — access details only appear after clicking a persona-specific signup CTA.
api_surface: Unknown surface; go-to-market is explicitly agent/MCP-first, which is notable in itself.
mcp: Claimed on homepage (MCP SSE), not independently verified
blocker: No publicly readable API/MCP reference docs exist to evaluate without creating an account — a real product that markets agent-readiness but doesn't document it in the open.
verification_note: CORRECTED after manual check: first pass wrongly treated this as an unverifiable/possibly-fake app. It's real and unusually agent-forward, just undocumented publicly.

name: QuickBooks
one_liner: Intuit's small-business accounting software.
access_note: Free Intuit developer account + free Sandbox company file, fully self-serve instant.

name: Xero
one_liner: Cloud accounting software, QuickBooks competitor.
access_note: Free developer account + demo company, self-serve instant.

name: Brex
one_liner: Corporate card and spend-management platform.
auth: Bearer user token (generated from the Brex dashboard, not a full OAuth2 flow)
access_note: Confirmed via docs: token generation requires signing in to dashboard.brex.com "as an account admin or card admin" — i.e. you must already be a Brex customer.
api_surface: REST API, moderate-broad (Accounting, Budgets, Expenses, Payments, Team, Transactions, Travel, Webhooks), but inaccessible without being a customer.
blocker: Must already be an approved paying Brex customer before any API credentials exist.
verification_note: Confirmed on manual check; corrected auth description from generic "OAuth2" to the actual dashboard-issued bearer token.

name: Ramp
one_liner: Corporate card and expense-management platform (Brex competitor).
access_note: A Developer Sandbox program exists but is application/waitlist-based, not instant self-serve; production credentials require an active Ramp customer account.
blocker: Sandbox application/waitlist plus customer-account requirement for production.

name: PitchBook
one_liner: Private-market financial data and research platform.
access_note: Confirmed on manual check (real browser got through where our crawler's plain HTTP request was blocked with 403): PitchBook does advertise a Data Feed/API/CRM/LLM-partnership product, but the only call to action anywhere is a "Request a free trial" sales-lead form (name, email, phone, company) — no public docs, pricing, or self-serve signup exist.
api_surface: An API product exists commercially, but zero public technical surface to evaluate.
blocker: Fully enterprise/contact-sales; nothing to build against without first going through a sales lead form and a commercial data license.
crawler_note: Our plain-HTTP crawler got HTTP 403; a real browser session was not blocked, but found only a lead-gen form, not docs — worth noting bot-blocking and "no self-serve docs" are two separate findings that happened to coincide here.

name: NotebookLM
one_liner: Google's AI research/notebook assistant.
auth: Google Cloud IAM / OAuth2 (Enterprise API only)
access_note: The consumer NotebookLM product has no public API; the "Gemini Notebook Enterprise" API exists but is Enterprise-only, with some features allowlist-gated.
api_surface: REST API (Enterprise), moderate, preview status on parts of it.
blocker: Enterprise-only access plus allowlisting for preview features.

name: Otter AI
one_liner: AI meeting transcription and notes.
access_note: Individuals can connect via the official Otter.ai MCP server (OAuth, per-meeting permissions) self-serve; the separate raw Public API is beta and Enterprise-plan-gated via account manager.
api_surface: MCP server (self-serve) plus a gated Enterprise REST API.
blocker: The general-purpose Public API needs an Enterprise plan and account-manager contact; only the MCP path is broadly self-serve.

name: Fathom
one_liner: AI meeting recorder and notetaker.
access_note: Generate an API key straight from Settings, no approval; anyone can browse the docs and build.

name: Consensus
one_liner: AI-powered academic research search engine.
access_note: API access is Enterprise-only; the interactive API explorer itself requires a paid Enterprise account to even view.
api_surface: REST API with OAuth, documented but locked behind Enterprise.
blocker: No public docs or trial; Enterprise sales contact required just to see the API.

name: Reducto
one_liner: Document parsing/understanding API for AI pipelines.
access_note: Self-serve signup at platform.reducto.ai, 15,000 free credits, no sales call.

name: Devin
one_liner: Cognition's autonomous AI software engineer.
access_note: Official MCP server exists, but requires an active (paid) Devin account; no evidence of a free public tier.
blocker: Must already be a paying Devin customer to obtain API/MCP credentials.

name: higgsfield
one_liner: AI image/video generation suite with an agent-facing CLI.
access_note: Sign up on Higgsfield Console and generate server-side credentials — self-serve.
api_surface: REST API + official Python/Node SDKs + CLI, moderate.
blocker: Non-standard dual-part key format needs bespoke auth handling versus a plain bearer token.

name: Mermaid CLI
one_liner: Open-source CLI that renders Mermaid diagrams to images.
access_note: No account, no auth; runs as a local Node.js subprocess.
api_surface: Not a hosted API — a local rendering tool, same different-shape case as Sherlock.
blocker: Would ship as a local-execution skill, not an API-based toolkit.

name: YouTube Transcript
one_liner: Third-party API for pulling YouTube video transcripts (transcriptapi.com).
access_note: Free tier (25 requests/month) plus paid tiers, no approval process.

name: Grain
one_liner: AI meeting recorder and highlight-reel tool.
access_note: Generate a token self-serve under Settings > Integrations > API.
api_surface: REST API, moderate (recordings, transcripts, notes, webhooks).
